caption: The tool step of the job builder shows what costs credits: qualifying and custom questions are free, skills tests cost 0 to 1 credit, video questions 1 and AI interviews 2. ID verification needs an upgrade. The sample ID photo in the vendor illustration is hidden.
The candidate preview only shows sample questions. TestGorilla says each test draws random questions from a bank of 1,500+, so the preview is not the exact test a candidate gets.
Inside the app, Assessments Core costs EUR 66 a month billed annually for 250 credits a year, so EUR 792 paid up front. The credits are pooled for the year, not handed out per month.
Our account on Assessment Free: 10 credits a month that reset on the 1st, 0 of 10 used. The test user row is hidden.

The public pricing page in euros shows Assessments Core from EUR 66 and Plus from EUR 345 a month, billed annually. The text version of the same page said Core from $215, so the starting price depends on the view.
